Erdogan raises Kashmir issue at UN General Assembly

Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan raised the issue of Kashmir at the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), calling for dialogue under the UN Charter. This occurred days after Turkey signed a defence pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia.
